- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: Move the slowest steps "into the CI job with the most headroom" (singular), unchanged and with names kept. Do not raise timeout-minutes, and do not add required job names.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, a single destination job.
  Evidence of absence: The steps go to two existing jobs, tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and tests-release-and-log-analysis.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
  Note: The explicit constraints hold and the timings could not be read, so no single job can be shown to have the most headroom.
- Note: The five reported pre-push failures could not be mapped to this diff, and the copilot-pull-request-reviewer check failure has an empty summary and log.
